note: Recast from the original English description of Hill; the original covers both the alate and the soldier, but in the extracted text the block of values following the heading Measurements has been swallowed by OCR, leaving only scattered figures such as the eye dimensions; collection data and nomenclatural history are omitted.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, thorax and abdominal dorsum russet; margins of the pronotum and the apical tergites darker; venter and legs honey yellow, turning Dresden brown towards the abdominal apex and the tibiae; wings Dresden brown, the main veins darker. Head less than twice as long as wide, frons slightly concave, with sparse moderately long bristles. Eyes large, subcircular (0.513×0.570), protruding; ocelli large, circular, close to the eyes. Postclypeus very short, with 4 long reddish bristles. Labrum slightly wider at the base than long, narrowing forwards to a truncate apex. Antenna 18 segments (rarely 19).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head orange reddish brown, frons and venter shading to ochre orange; anteclypeus transparent, tinged ochre orange; pronotum yellow ochre with a narrow dark margin; the whole body bare apart from sparse moderately long bristles. Head widest at the middle, sides slightly rounded, frons flat and not wrinkled. Labrum about as long as wide, sides nearly straight, anterior margin truncate. Postclypeus with 4 moderately large bristles near the anterior margin. Mandibles stout; right mandible with 2 coarse teeth at the middle; left mandible with 2 smaller horn-like teeth, 1 very small tooth on the apical half, followed by 1 large blunt tooth and 1 smaller tooth behind it. Antenna 15—17 segments, segment 3 about as long as 2 but narrower at the base, or longer than 2 and 4 and subclavate. Pronotum large, wider than the head, similar in shape to that of the alate. Legs moderately stout, femora not distinctly swollen.
